versions.text: Meridian Signal Group brings digital publishing, streaming entertainment, podcasts, and live events together to connect people with original ideas.

Meridian Signal Group creates space for original ideas across digital publishing, streaming entertainment, podcasts, and live events. Our focus is thoughtful storytelling and meaningful connections with audiences.
Meridian Signal Group is exploring new ways for audiences to discover original stories across our creative portfolio.
Streamline is Meridian Signal Group’s entertainment service, bringing a curated collection of original series to viewers in participating markets.
Streamline will introduce a new collection of original series this season. Availability and release dates will be confirmed for each participating market.
Streamline is preparing a refreshed discovery experience for viewers. Further details will be shared after the review process is complete.
Meridian Signal Group’s publications make editorial decisions through their respective editorial teams, guided by clear standards for accuracy and fairness.
Our editors lead the selection, development, and publication of stories. Commercial relationships do not determine editorial conclusions.
Meridian Signal Group’s editorial teams are reviewing an updated set of publication standards.
Meridian Signal Group works with podcast creators to bring distinctive perspectives and carefully produced stories to listeners.
Our podcast portfolio gives original voices room to explore ideas through thoughtful conversations and distinctive storytelling.
Meridian Signal Group plans to expand its podcast development programme with a new group of creators.
Meridian Signal Group’s live events bring creators and audiences together for conversations, performances, and shared experiences.
Our EMEA live events programme brings creators and audiences together for thoughtfully produced conversations and performances. Each event publishes its own access and attendance information.
Our Americas live events programme connects audiences with creators through conversations and performances. Each event publishes its own access and attendance information.
Meridian Signal Group develops partnerships around shared creative goals and a clear understanding of each partner’s responsibilities.
We work with partners to develop distinctive experiences, agreeing the purpose, responsibilities, and permitted uses of each collaboration before launch.
Meridian Signal Group is preparing a revised partnership framework for future creative collaborations.
Meridian Signal Group supports colleagues through clear working agreements and regular conversations with their teams.
Our teams use shared working agreements to support focused work, collaboration, and flexibility. Colleagues can discuss individual arrangements with their team lead.
We are reviewing how team working agreements can better support collaboration across our creative portfolio.
Meridian Signal Group is reviewing how production teams can reduce avoidable resource use while maintaining creative quality.
Our production teams are testing practical ways to use materials more carefully and reduce avoidable travel. We will describe results when the review is complete.
Meridian Signal Group is developing updated guidance on resource use in production. This wording remains under review.
